generalAbilities.name: Slow
generalAbilities.description: The zombie chuul is permanently Slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(1d12+7) Bludgeoning Damage damage, Basic DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw (Grabbed by claw only)

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Mandibles
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements A creature is Grabbed and Paralyzed by the zombie chuul's tentacles

Effect The creature takes 3d6 Piercing Damage damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralytic Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 Paralyzed (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Tentacle Transfer
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The zombie chuul has a creature Grabbed

Effect The zombie chuul transfers the grabbed creature from its claws to its tentacles, or vice versa. The creature is exposed to the zombie chuul's paralytic venom when transferred into the tentacles and at the start of each of the zombie chuul's turns if it remains grabbed by the tentacles.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
